services.name: Take a Walk Down Memory Lane
services.desc: Every artifact sparks a memory.Whether your group is reminiscing about growing up on the farm, sharing stories with grandchildren, or simply enjoying a day out together, the Stony Plain & Parkland Pioneer Museum offers guided tours that are relaxed, engaging, and tailored to your group. Our knowledgeable volunteers and staff bring local history to life through stories, demonstrations, and conversations that often inspire visitors to share memories of their own. You're welcome to bring your own lunch and enjoy our beautiful picnic areas, or let us arrange a light lunch or refreshments for your group for an additional fee. The Pioneer Museum is located behind Heritage Park in Stony Plain.

services.name: Model Train Exhibit
services.desc: The main model train display, which is housed in a 5’ x 25’ replica of a rail car of the period, depicts Parkland County in the early 1900’s after the rail track had been laid and trains started to service the area. The rail system was instrumental in developing the area west of Edmonton during this period. Main Street, Stony Plain is depicted in the picture. The re-creation of the first town block includes buildings from 1908-1920, including Miller bros. General Merchant, Kelly’s Saloon, Opperthauser’s Hardware Store, and the Royal Hotel.
